shots.text: Every survivor of every city was inside Solenne now. The Emberfolk with their iron pots of fire. The Galeborn and their horses. The Deepwood with their seed. Pearlhaven's children. The Stoneborn. The Veilwalkers.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Wide shot of Solenne crammed with every people of the Ring, each lighting a small light in its own colour. The city glows like a lantern in the black.

shots.text: We had no more cities to give.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Ysolde climbing the inner wall, Tamsin at her arm, the heroes along the battlements.

shots.text:
For twenty-six cities we bought time with stone. There is no more stone. There is only us.

Hold this wall, and nobody has to run again.
shots.speaker: ysolde
shots.art_note: Ysolde on the wall, blindfolded, facing out over the dark plain where the Unbound are gathering in every colour. In the centre of the horde, a vast floating knot of shattered light: the Sundered Heart.

shots.text: ...There's a light on the east road. Does nobody else see it?
shots.speaker: ysolde
shots.art_note: Ysolde turning her blind face east. Tamsin looks: nothing but darkness.
